detail: [never] EN:"Alright alright, just calm down. We were never here, we didn't see anything…" ZH:'好吧好吧，冷静点。我们没来过这里，什么都没看见……'
[all] EN:"It's true, I worked for the Wizard for a while. We sold that “magical” water all over the place." ZH:'是真的，我为水之术士工作了一段时间。我们到处卖“神奇”的水。'
[must] EN:'It must be Coach! Mocking us!' ZH:'一定是教练！他在嘲笑我们！'
[must] EN:'My temporal sensors went out in the Great War. That must have been a week ago at least.' ZH:'我的时间传感器在大战中受损了，估计至少是一周前的事了。'

[after] EN:'When you need new Dwellers you can always encourage your Dwellers to procreate.

- Put a man and a woman in th' ZH:'当您需要新居民时，您可以鼓励您的居民多生育。

- 将一个男人和女人放在宿舍里，看看他们是不是喜欢对方。

- 如果一切顺利的话，女方将会怀孕。

- 过一段时间，怀孕的居民就可以分娩了。

- 点击她头上的图标，会有新'
[before] EN:'Hint: Be careful not to build rooms before you need them, or expand too fast.' ZH:'提示：请记住不要建造超出需求的房间，或者扩张得过快。'
[all] EN:'Our brahmin drank it all. Who can say no to golden dung? Try the abandoned Vault-Tec offices.' ZH:'我们的双头牛一饮而尽。谁能对金色的粪便说不？去废弃的避难所科技办公室试试看吧。'
[after] EN:'Absolutely. You are, after all, the most powerful Horseman.' ZH:'好的。你，毕竟是，最强大的骑士。'
[never] EN:'The chef never ceases to be amazed by your uncanny ability to escape death, and he wants to celebrate it with ' ZH:'大厨对你死里逃生的能力表示惊讶。他想用辐射蝎蛋卷来庆祝。923号避难所最近被这些生物侵占了，不妨就从那里开始吧。'
[never] EN:"What is this? Ah yes. I'm hovering over a minefield. I'll never be envious of legs again." ZH:'这是什么？啊，原来我正在雷区上啊。我再也不会羡慕别的生物有腿了。'
[must] EN:'Hint: Dwellers in Barbershops must fight Incidents alone, so equip them well.' ZH:'提示：美发店里的居民只能独自对抗灾害，所以请给他们好的武器和装备。'
[all] EN:'Looky here, someone got through all the rookies. What, you think you can take us?' ZH:'看这里，有人打败了那些菜鸟。怎么，你们觉得能打败我们？'
[never] EN:'My husband would never aband... Oh, you want to go? Fine then. Go.' ZH:'我丈夫永远不会抛……哦，你想走了？那好，你走吧。'
[all] EN:'All this walking is murder on my feet.' ZH:'这一路走下来，我这双脚可遭了大罪。'
[all] EN:"“All right, I've got to give you Dwellers credit." ZH:'好吧，我得承认，你们这些居民确实有两下子。'
[never] EN:'I never did understand the concept of legs, or moving them. For goodness sake, humans... HOVER.' ZH:'我一直不明白腿有什么用，或者说为什么要动它们。人类啊，你们就不能漂浮起来吗？'
[all] EN:'For those times when all you have is a big gem, but what you need is a killing machine.' ZH:'当你手头只有一块大宝石，却需要一件致命武器时。'
[every] EN:'It jams every now and then, but so what? Still great.' ZH:'偶尔会堵塞，但那又怎样呢？还是很强大的。'
[after] EN:'After all, the food at the wedding was awful! Why risk our lives for them?' ZH:'不管怎么说，婚礼上的食物太难吃了！为什么要冒着自己的生命危险来做这些？'
[never] EN:"If I go home empty handed I'll never hear the end of it..." ZH:'要是我空手而归，估计会被人唠叨个没完没了……'
[never] EN:'Death by junk was never so shocking.' ZH:'你一定不知道杂物致死如此令人震惊。'
[all] EN:"On behalf of everyone living there peacefully, thank you for all that you've done.”" ZH:'我代表每个在这里和平生活的人，由衷感谢你们。”'
[every] EN:'My child is so perfect, I feel sorry for every other parent in here.' ZH:'我的孩子太完美了，我都替这里其他的家长感到心疼。'
[all] EN:'And I am here to give back to all wrestling fans!' ZH:'我来这里就是为了回馈我的粉丝们！'
[never] EN:"He didn't say. Not that it matters, you're never leaving this room alive!" ZH:'他没说什么。但有什么关系，反正你们是不可能活着从这个房间走出去的！'
[never] EN:'Need help with this crossword. Nine letters. Starts with “c” and ends with “d.” Means, “A horror you can never' ZH:'帮我解个填字游戏。四个字，“一场永远逃不掉的恐怖”。'
[never] EN:"No, we've never heard of you, gramp." ZH:'不记得了，我们从没听说过你啊，老头儿。'
[all] EN:'Raiders will come from all over to serve War. Or else face his wrath. And his morning breath.' ZH:'掠夺者会从四面八方赶来为“战争”效力，否则就要面对他的怒火。还有他的晨间口臭。'
[never] EN:'Ahhh, education. The only thing they can never take truly\xa0away from you.\xa0' ZH:'啊，教育。这是他们唯一永远无法真正从你身上夺走的东西。'
[never] EN:"If I die out here, they'll never know..." ZH:'如果我死在这里，他们永远不会知道……'
[every] EN:"Every day's a good day when I'm on the job!" ZH:'只要上了班，天天都是好日子！'
[must] EN:'Intruders! You must be the ones that freed our prisoners.' ZH:'入侵者！那个把我们的囚犯放走的人一定是你们。'
[must] EN:"Oh good. You must be the one who's going to take down Shiner." ZH:'哦太好了。你应该就是那个能拿下“闪闪”的人。'
[all] EN:'Hmm... Maybe we should all paint the Vault a different color.' ZH:'嗯……也许咱们该一起给避难所刷个别的颜色。'
[never] EN:"“I once shot a Deathclaw in my pajamas. How he got in my pajamas I'll never know.”" ZH:'我曾经穿着睡衣射杀了一只死爪。至于它是怎么钻进我睡衣里的，我永远也不会知道。'
[never] EN:'I never meant to hurt anyone!' ZH:'我从没想过伤害任何人！'
[all] EN:'Find out all that and more when the story continues in Part 2!' ZH:'想知道更多故事，请关注第2部！'
[must] EN:"Rad detector's going crazy. Must be those green barrels..." ZH:'辐射探测器都快响疯了。肯定是那些绿色桶……'
[all] EN:'Hint: A room merge only happens if all rooms are of the same level.' ZH:'提示：当房间的等级一致时才能合并。'
[never] EN:'Sure, as long as you promise never to enter a pageant again.' ZH:'好啊，只要你保证别再参赛了。'
[only] EN:"Test your skills as Overseer in this season's new Experimental Vault! Experimental Vaults introduce fresh twis" ZH:'在本赛季新实验避难所中考验您作为监督者的实力！实验避难所引入全新玩法和独家奖励。赛季时间有限——千万别错过！'
[only] EN:'Robes of honor, worn only by Brotherhood of Steel Elders.' ZH:'荣耀的长袍，被钢铁兄弟会长老们穿过。'
[after] EN:"Don't tell me you're after Shaun's treasure too..." ZH:'不要告诉我你也想要尚恩的宝藏……'
[every] EN:"You humans relax. No, no. It's fine. I'll just selflessly tend to your every need..." ZH:'你们人类歇着吧。不不，不用管我。我就默默无私地伺候各位的一切需求……'
[never] EN:"They'll never make fun of a science nerd again." ZH:'他们再不会取笑一个科学呆子了。'
[never] EN:'Never heard of him. But you get to... Lose Your Head!' ZH:'从没听说过他。你要准备……“掉脑袋”！'
[all] EN:"The odd spike may not pin a limb to a wall, but it'll kill all the same." ZH:'这个奇怪的尖钉可能不能将四肢钉在墙上，但它还是一样能杀戮。'
[after] EN:"Some newlyweds from a nearby settlement went to a secluded cave to “celebrate” in private. They haven't return" ZH:'来自附近定居点的某对新婚夫妇去了一个偏僻的山洞“度蜜月”。他们至今未归，第一批救援队也一去不回！也许关于辐射蝎的传闻是真的。最好带上家伙！'
[before] EN:"Fortunately, I hid the bomb's main circuit board before running away." ZH:'幸运的是，我在逃跑前把炸弹的主电路板藏起来了。'

[before] EN:"We've received information that Vault 317 contains clover samples from before the Great War. This hardy, nutri" ZH:'我们已经收到信息，317号避难所有战前的三叶草样品。这种耐寒，营养丰富的杂草，据说已经灭绝了，现在证明可以是我们重要的主食。如果有的话，我们需要把这些样品带回来！'
[all] EN:"Wonderful! The day we've all worked toward is close at hand!" ZH:'精彩的！我们一起努力的目标就在眼前！'
[all] EN:'Sorry you came all this way. Here, maybe this will make up for it.' ZH:'抱歉让你们跑那么远来这里。这个拿着，当做是一点补偿。'
[only] EN:"I'm not only going to embarrass you, I'm gonna take you out for good!" ZH:'我不光要让你出丑，还要把你彻底做掉！'
[must] EN:"Wait a minute. Are those... claw marks? They're... glowing. Must be getting close now." ZH:'等等，这些是……爪印吗？他们正在……发光。应该就在附近。'
[all] EN:'Hey, is that a Mr. Handy? All right!' ZH:'嘿，那是一个巧手先生吗？太棒了！'
[never] EN:'Super, now go tell others never to come here because everything is normal ha ha.' ZH:'太棒了，现在去告诉别人永远不要来这里，因为一切都是正常的哈哈。'
[all] EN:'Of course! It all makes sense now! Here, for your vital assistance!' ZH:'当然！现在说得通了！来拿着，可以在关键时候帮助你！'
[all] EN:'You mean, apart from drinking green beer? Nope. Nothing at all.' ZH:'你的意思是，除了喝绿色啤酒？不。没影儿的事。'
[never] EN:'An itsy bitsy teeny weeny ye... Never mind.' ZH:'一件很小很小的小小的……衣服。唉算了。'
[must] EN:"If you are here, you must've carved your way through the Radscorpions. Impressive!" ZH:'你们能到这里，肯定一路杀穿了辐射蝎。厉害！'
[before] EN:"That's fine, but do put on a hat before you go out. It's cold outside." ZH:'好吧，但是出去前一定戴上帽子。外面挺冷的。'
[after] EN:'What are the Hubologists after?' ZH:'赫伯基信徒们追寻的是什么东西？'
[all] EN:'Recipe? All I have is this blueprint for weaponized marinara.' ZH:'配方吗？我只有这张“武器化番茄酱”的蓝图。'
[all] EN:'I think we can all get along! We can help each other!' ZH:'我想我们可以和平相处！我们可以互相帮助！'
[all] EN:"All we have is holiday cheer! Now let's sing some songs!" ZH:'我们只有欢快的节日气氛！让我们一起来唱唱歌吧！'
[all] EN:"Love is in the air, and just like radioactive fallout  - once it gets inside you it doesn't get out! All we ne" ZH:'空气中弥漫着爱意，就像放射性尘埃——一旦进入体内就再也出不来！我们现在需要的是一枚戒指来求婚。在附近的废弃建筑里说不定能找到一些战前珠宝。'
[never] EN:"Manage? So you're here for Mr. Manager. You will never take him away! He tells us stories!" ZH:'管理？所以你是来找经理大人的。你休想带走他！他给我们讲故事！'
[must] EN:"You must mean Mr. Manager. He's staying with us! He tells us stories! And now you die!" ZH:'你说的一定是经理大人。他现在和我们在一起！他给我们讲故事！而你们，去死吧！'
[first] EN:'No way! Soldiers caused this mess in the first place.' ZH:'没门！最初的混乱就是那些士兵造成的。'
[never] EN:"Then you'll never leave here alive!" ZH:'那你恐怕无法活着出去了！'
[before] EN:"Oh, yes, let's develop atomic energy. Because that worked out sssooo well before..." ZH:'哦对了，一起来开发原子能吧。上次开发原子能的结果可真是太棒了……'
[before] EN:'Standard issue for soldiers before the Great War.' ZH:'战前士兵的标准装备。'
[all] EN:"It's a Glowing Radscorpion! And the suits all the Pests wear protect them from its radiation." ZH:'这是一只发光辐射蝎！那些“害虫”穿着的防护服能让他们免受它的辐射。'
[before] EN:'How about a story before dinner?' ZH:'晚饭前讲个故事怎么样？'
[all] EN:"Wow. That's not a loaded question at all." ZH:'哇。这可真是个别有用心的问题。'
[never] EN:'Of course we are! The Overseer would never let anything happen to us!' ZH:'当然了！监督者不会让我们发生任何意外的！'
[only] EN:'If only I had the endurance to deal with idiots like you.' ZH:'要是我有足够的耐力来应付你这种白痴就好了。'
[every] EN:'Every step, used chems and empty liquor bottles. That explains so much.' ZH:'到处都是用过的药剂和空酒瓶，这很能说明问题了。'
[all] EN:"I came here to drink Nuka-Cola and kill chumps like you. And I'm all out of Nuka-Cola." ZH:'我来这里是为了喝核子可乐和杀掉像你们这样的蠢蛋。而且我的核子可乐喝完了。'
[every] EN:"You humans relax. No, no. It's fine. I'll just selflessly tend to your every need..." ZH:'你们人类歇着吧。不不，不用管我。我就默默无私地伺候各位的一切需求……'
[all] EN:'“Woe is me, woe is me, for I am unworthy. But Pestilence is great, all glowing and...”' ZH:'我是悲哀的，悲哀是我，因为我不配。但“瘟疫”是伟大的，散发圣光和……'
[must] EN:"This must be the leader. Let's send it to the scrapyard." ZH:'这肯定是领头的。把它送进废铁场。'
[all] EN:"Steve, all-knowing? You're clearly *not* from here..." ZH:'史蒂夫，无所不知？你显然不是来自于这里……'
[all] EN:"Correct! Let's all lay down our arms and re-read that classic episode." ZH:'正确！让我们放松，来重温下经典的剧情。'
[all] EN:'So, is there any food left here at all?' ZH:'那么，这里还有食物吗？'
[all] EN:"We won't even need to find your Vault if you all keep coming to us like this." ZH:'如果你一直这样来找我们的话，我们甚至不需要找到你的避难所。'
[never] EN:'Never heard of fist prints before, but I supp- Ooh, I get it.' ZH:'以前从没听说过拳印，但我想——哦，我懂了。'
[all] EN:'Breaking bones is all fun at first, but sooner or later one of these psychos is gonna turn on you.' ZH:'粉碎骨头开始还挺好玩的，但迟早他们中就会有一个变态开始针对你们。'
[every] EN:'Thinks every day is Caturday.' ZH:'认为天天都是爱猫日。'
[only] EN:'If my parents could only see me now...' ZH:'要是爸妈能看到我现在这副样子就好了……'
[after] EN:'Wow. Sometimes it just feels like one room after another...' ZH:'哇，有时候感觉就是一个房间接着一个房间，永无止境……'
[every] EN:'Every spot is a weak spot for this lead spewing beast.' ZH:'对这个子弹喷射猛兽来说，哪里都是弱点！'
[all] EN:'These Khans are so careless. Leaving all this nice stuff lying around!' ZH:'这些大汗帮真粗心，把这么多好东西随便乱放！'
[before] EN:"A child's wooden blocks. From before the war. I wonder where... Oh." ZH:'小孩的木制积木，来自战前。我好奇那个小孩……哦。'
[never] EN:"What is this? Ah yes. I'm hovering over a minefield. I'll never be envious of legs again." ZH:'这是什么？啊，原来我正在雷区上啊。我再也不会羡慕别的生物有腿了。'
[all] EN:"All it takes is a better scope and you're blasting baddies like a champ." ZH:'只要换上更好的瞄准镜……'
[never] EN:'In the Wasteland, some forms of protection never go out of style.' ZH:'在废土上，有些保护形式永远不会过时的。'
[before] EN:'I used to play quarterback for them! Before the war...' ZH:'我曾为他们打四分卫！就在战前……'
[only] EN:'<Carefully spray only the eggs>' ZH:'<仔细喷洒蛋>'
[after] EN:"Time to go after something a little smarter: Feral Ghouls! And speaking of smart, you'll have to do it wearing" ZH:'是时候去对付更聪明的目标了：狂尸鬼！说到聪明——你还得穿着实验服去干！'
[never] EN:"Well it's mine, and you'll never find it! - Coach”" ZH:'呃，它是我的，而你们永远不可能找到它！——教练”'
[must] EN:"What's that smell? Is... EW. Plumbing must be backed up again." ZH:'那是什么味儿？是……呕，管道肯定又堵了。'
[never] EN:'Surprisingly reasonable. Leave this place and never return.' ZH:'意外地合理。离开这个地方，再也不要回来。'
[only] EN:'Hmm. Maybe. But only if I can deal.' ZH:'嗯。也许吧。除非让我发牌。'
[never] EN:"Novac has never been so strong and free. Here, I'll show you just how free you can be!" ZH:'诺瓦克从来没有这么强大自由过。来，我让你亲身体验一下何谓自由！'
[before] EN:"We need to find Vault 525, but our supplies are running low. It's time to visit the Super Duper Mart and scave" ZH:'我们需要找到525号避难所，但我们的物资告急。得去大无敌超市搜索一切能用的东西，然后继续上路。'
[never] EN:'I did? Oh, never mind then. As you were.' ZH:'是吗？哦，那算了。当我没说。'
[every] EN:'Would it kill them to dust every now and then?' ZH:'他们时不时打扫一下这里会死吗？'
[never] EN:'Oh yeah, that... Never mind that. Just find some eggs.' ZH:'哦，是的，那个……请别介意。只是找一些蛋。'
[all] EN:'Oh, I do so wish they would allow me to tend the garden. I come with all the right attachments.' ZH:'哦，我真希望他们能让我打理花园。毕竟我自带各种工具。'
[before] EN:"The Overseer's son got married to a Raider, but she sold him to Slavers! We have to catch them before they dis" ZH:'监督者的儿子和一个掠夺者结婚了，但她把他卖给了奴隶贩子！我们必须赶紧抓住他们！'
[must] EN:"You must be a genie, because you're making my dreams come true." ZH:'你一定是个精灵，因为你让我美梦成真。'
[all] EN:"Now all you need is a Rocket '69 and a pompadour." ZH:'你现在只需要《69号火箭》和大背头了。'
[all] EN:"Yeah! Like we're all just pawns in some game..." ZH:'是的！我们就像是某盘棋里任人摆布的棋子……'
[never] EN:'I never did understand the concept of legs, or moving them. For goodness sake, humans... HOVER.' ZH:'我一直不明白腿有什么用，或者说为什么要动它们。人类啊，你们就不能漂浮起来吗？'
[never] EN:"Don't worry. That was never on my agenda." ZH:'别担心。从来就不在我的日程安排里。'
[after] EN:'A cat burglar has been hitting Vault after Vault, taking pets away from their owners. Stop them before they st' ZH:'一个“飞贼”接连光顾一个个避难所，把宠物从主人身边偷走。趁他偷走下一只猫之前阻止他！'
[all] EN:'This is the square root of all evil.' ZH:'这是万恶的平方根。'
[all] EN:'And I shall not stop until all are equal!' ZH:'不实现平等，我决不罢休！'
[all] EN:"Hey, we're all for that! We've got some robots back at the Vault and they're basically family!" ZH:'没错！我们避难所也有一些机器人，他们基本上就是我们的家人！'
[all] EN:"I'm just here to learn. Not put up with this know-it-all." ZH:'我只是来学习的，不是来受这个自以为是家伙的气的。'
[after] EN:'Running after the Brahmin to help out the Merchant. That thing is fast!' ZH:'帮助商人追逐双头牛。那东西很快！'
[all] EN:'Will the Horsemen be stopped once and for all?' ZH:'骑士们会被一劳永逸地阻止吗？'
[must] EN:'I smell something foul! Coach must have been here recently!' ZH:'我闻到了腐臭的味道！教练应该不久前就在这儿！'

[only] EN:"The notorious Raider, Sally Switchblade, is getting married to the infamous Marcus Hammer. But they're both ha" ZH:'臭名昭著的掠夺者“刀锋萨莉”准备和另一个声名狼藉的掠夺者“铁锤马克斯”结婚了。但双方都还有点犹豫，因为他们都不想再作为掠夺者生活了。问题是他们根本不知道该怎么交流！赶紧介入帮他们解决问题吧。'
[all] EN:"Ugh. You're right, of course. All right, back to work, I suppose…" ZH:'唉，你说得对。好吧，看来我得继续回去工作了……'
[only] EN:'Okay, maybe 77 is an exaggeration, but there are a lot of them, and only one of you. Have you got what it take' ZH:'好吧，也许77太夸张了，但他们那么多人，而你就一个。你有那么大本事吗？'
[all] EN:"You're kidding, right? Radscorpion. All the way." ZH:'你在开玩笑吧？当然是辐射蝎。必须选它。'
[first] EN:'Welcome to our first annual E-Ster Egg Hunt!' ZH:'欢迎来到我们一年一度复活节彩蛋寻宝！'
